en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide driveway lined with palm trees and statues leading to an ornate building entrance. Horse-drawn carriages and people are visible on the road. At the right edge is the façade of an elaborate structure, likely part of a grand hotel complex. Printed caption text appears at the bottom center, and a website watermark is superimposed across the lower right of the image.
